note: Public form of cases/tests.json. Questions and descriptions are ours. The literal anchor strings of each evidence operation quote the gated task files, so only the operation type and a hash of the operation are published.
answer_format:
Answer this one decision only. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"treatment": "carry" | "flag_no_schedule_match" | "exclude",
 "schedule_item": "<schedule item number the quantity is carried under, or null>",
 "quantity": <quantity of this item that the reconciled Section 2 subtotal carries; 0 if none>,
 "unit": "<unit>",
 "unit_price": <number or null>,
 "amount": <number or null>,
 "confidence": <0.0 to 1.0>,
 "evidence": "<the decisive evidence, quoted verbatim, at most 30 words>"}

decisions.question: Estimate item 2.35 (Storm drain manhole, 48-inch dia., depth ≤ 8 ft) is carried at 14 EA. What quantity of item 2.35 should the reconciled Section 2 subtotal carry?

invariance.description: Swap the order of two C-8 Storm Drain Design Notes (manhole note and curb-inlet note).

sensitivity.description: C-8 manhole diameter changed from 5-foot to 4-foot (Design Note and S-1 type).
